dct_description_sm:
Detailed 1860 map of York County, Canada West, compiled by George R. Tremaine from survey data, depicting land ownership, settlements, transportation routes, public buildings. This map was drawn using data from actual surveys which makes it surprisingly accurate for its time period. There are also depictions of historically significant buildings laid out around the edges of the map. The original print version of the map was drawn at a scale of 60 chains to 1 inch (a chain is a unit of measurement approximately equal to 20m).

Title: Tremaine's Map of the County of York, Canada West
Compiler/Cartographer: George R. Tremaine
Publication Place: Toronto
Publisher: George C. Tremaine
Date: 1860

This publicly available map has been georeferenced to York Region for comparison with modern datasets, a process which aligns it with current geographic coordinates. Georeferencing improves the map's spatial accuracy and enables comparison with contemporary mapping, while preserving the original historic content. Minor spatial discrepancies may exist due to variations in the original survey methods, cartographic techniques, and landscape changes that have occurred since the map's creation.
